manufacturers.bioShort: UK luminaire manufacturer, founded 1896. Part of Acuity Brands. 125+ years designing exterior and architectural lighting.
manufacturers.bio: Founded in London in 1896 by Pelham Trotter, Holophane's first product was a patented glass refractor that gave the company its name and set the direction for everything that followed: lighting engineered around optical performance, not just styling. Now part of Acuity Brands and manufacturing from its Milton Keynes facility, Holophane designs exterior, industrial and architectural luminaires with a focus on thermal management, serviceability and long system life — built to be repaired and upgraded in the field rather than replaced. Lumen Method is Holophane's exclusive specification agent for Australia.

manufacturers.bioShort: Australian-made luminaires, founded 2014 in Somersby, NSW. Serviceable, high-performance lighting for demanding environments.
manufacturers.bio:
Australian Made. Designed to Last. Built to Endure.

Survivor Lighting is an Australian lighting manufacturer specialising in serviceable, high-performance luminaires designed for demanding environments where longevity, reliability and safety are paramount.

At the core of Survivor's philosophy is a commitment to long-term serviceability. Through considered product design, replaceable components and accessible construction, Survivor develops lighting solutions that simplify maintenance, extend operational life and reduce whole-of-life costs.

Combining Australian design and manufacturing expertise with robust mechanical engineering, Survivor produces purpose-built luminaires offering exceptional durability, impact resistance and tamper-resistant construction.

Its specialist range is suited to applications including correctional facilities, transport infrastructure, pedestrian underpasses, public amenities, healthcare facilities and other challenging environments where conventional lighting products may be unsuitable.

Survivor's approach brings together maintainability, durability and application-specific engineering to deliver sustainable lighting solutions designed for long-term performance. Lumen Method is Survivor Lighting's exclusive specification agent for Victoria and Tasmania.
